answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must register identities by locking jade tokens into cryptographic stake burning contracts. Registration fees increase exponentially with cluster size, enforcing superlinear cost scaling O(N^2) against attackers. Even a fierce gale of automated identities collapses as marginal attacker costs outpace linear utility.
